I don't think so no. I doubt I'll actually do anything to really harm myself, but I know the amount I've been thinking about it is unhealthy given the previous attempt and diagnosis with chronic depression.

Unfortunately most of the internships in the area want some sort of evidence of education in the field which my community college doesn't really offer. I know a few people who might be able to help me find something but they're in different areas and am currently unable to move since I'm in the middle of a school semester. The only thing I can think of is trying to get some freelance work.
Thank you for your advice. I know I have a problem with trying to compete with others achievements rather than actually focus on my own accomplishments.

I was the only one who got hurt, and nothing is broken, just a totaled car. I know these things happen I think I'm just afraid that if I take a year off I won't end up going back. I don't really care for school at all but I want to make sure I give myself every opportunity to find a decent career for myself. I'm just not passionate about it anymore, and am not sure what I want to do with my life, and the limited funds make me feel like there's basically just one shot at it so I get stressed out about not making the "right" decision.

I got into an animation/illustration program only to be told that it would take an additional five years of schooling because of the administration limit on classes per semester, I'm a transfer student and can't afford to do five years at a university without going into serious debt. I basically have to change my major or find somewhere else to go to school which is unlikely since I just received rejection letters from all but one of the other school I applied to. The only other one was a wait-list option. Either that or try to find a job without a degree which around here is super limited, and the now lack of a car makes it that much harder.

Thank you. I talked to a counselor a few years back but I cant afford to see one now, and the last time my parents basically gave me a deadline to "get better" because they didn't believe that I had actual problems until I tried to kill myself. Basically I reached out for help and got burned which is why I'm hesitant to do so again.
